⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Clears Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.

• Tshiamu tshidi tshituadija tshiakabidi panyima pa.

Udi mujadike anyi?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: udi utangila keybox udiku mpindieu ne Google's revocation list (CRL) ne udi uteta mishindu ya bungi too ne padiye upeta keybox muimpe, ne dilama dia bintu ne dijadikulula dia midimu ya Google. Udi wenza mudimu ku tshianza tshionso ne udi dijinga ne internet (minite 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox from network: udi wangata kazubu ka keybox mu tshilaminu tshia mbulamatadi (GitHub) ne utshilama mu /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Bidi bikengela internet ne bidi bilomba minite 1-3. Udi wenza mudimu padi smart fetch upangila anyi padi keybox mushintuluke ku bianza.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: udi utangila mishindu ya difila dia bintu bia ku bule, udi utangila TEE version wa mukanda wa dianyisha, ne uleja tshidi KmInstallKeybox tool state. Kakuena tshintu tshidi tshishintulula to — tshimuenenu tshia nsombelu wa tshiamu.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): shows Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) from dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, and related system properties. Kakushintulula tshintu nansha tshimue.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Udi ulongolola bilumbu bia dianyisha padi dipita dia automatique dipanga. Luendu luonso ludi luleja mulongo wa ditanta/dipanga.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Udi wenza mudimu ne bilumbu bikole ne udi wangata dîba dia bungi. Tshipeta tshimpe tshidi tshimueneka ku ndekelu.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: udi ujimija Play Store ne Google (GMS+GSF) data ne udi upingaja tshiamu tshia mudimu nkayatshi. Bua dijadika dia mutu mukole nkayadi — kadiena mua kulenga foto yebe anyi mikanda yebe to.
strings.mdCertify: • Dianyisha dia kunaya: udi utangila nsombelu wa dianyisha dia RKP wa tshiamu ne upingaja ngikadilu ya dianyisha padibi bikengela. Kawena ulenga malu a muena mudimu to.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: udi ulongolola Google services framework (SOTER) bilumbu bidi bitangila dijadika dia tshiamu. Udi wenza mudimu ne biamu bikuabu bidi bimanyine pa SOTER pamutu pa Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Enza PIF: wenza sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh bukole. Udi wenza mudimu ne tshimanyinu tshia munu tshisungula (tshia muaba/tshia kumpala) ne udi ushintulula pif.prop/pif.json mikanda. Tshipeta tshimpe tshidi tshimueneka mu tshikandakanda.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: udi uleja nsombelu wa motere muteka, mikanda ya bimanyinu bia minu (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ne mikanda. Tangila anu — kena ushintulula tshintu nansha tshimue.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Udi wangata tshintu tshipiatshipia tshia Canary Engine bua kujadika ne: tshidi tshiumvuangana ne mikanda ya RKP (mu ngondo muibidi 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Dikonkonona dia tshiamu: tshidi tshitangila nsombelu wa TrickyStoreOSS (pid, logs), mikanda ya tshibuta tshia tuzubu (tshidi tshienza mudimu anyi tshidi tshienza mudimu), tshimanyinu tshia tshianza tshia tshiamu tshia bushuwa anyi tshia dishima, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP tufungu. Dileja dia tshikebelu anu.
strings.hintKbSlots: Tshiamu etshi tshidi tshilombola miaba ibidi ya tuzubu: wa kumpala (wa tshijila, kayi muanji kujimijibua) ne wa buibidi (wa tshijila). Tab ewu udi uleja tshitupa tshidi tshienza mudimu, tshishintulula tshiudi musue, anyi tshibandisha tshibidi ku tshia kumpala pa dilomba dia patoke — ne bintu bia kulama ne tshikandakanda tshijima.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Dikonkonona dia bulelela: didi dikonkonona TEE dibueja dia tshifungu, dibueja dia tshilaminu tshia mikanda munda mua keystore2, nsombelu wa dijimija (CRL), tshibuikidiji tshia liste wa bukubi ne nsombelu wa RKP. Dibala anu — kadiena dishintulula bualu nansha bumue.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• The protection list is rebuilt from every installed app.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The active keybox is re-applied.
#000#s services are #000# restarted.

Kakuena tshintu tshidi tshijimijibua ne tshibuta tshia kumpala katshiena tshilenga to.

Tungunuka anyi?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: udi uleja nsombelu wa primary ne secondaire slots ne udi ushintulula tshiudi musue pankatshi pawu. Tshia kumpala (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) tshidi tshilama misangu yonso ne katshiena tshijimijibua nansha kakese. Kubandisha tshia buibidi ku tshia kumpala kudi kulomba dijadika dia patoke.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Kubandisha tshitupa tshibidi ku tshia kumpala:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml udi ulua tshintu tshia kumpala.
• Tshia kumpala tshidi tshilama bu tshintu tshia kulama kumpala kua kutshipingaja.
• Kakuena tshintu tshidi tshijimija to — mudimu udi mua kupingana.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Umbusha tshitupa tshibidi:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml neapatuke.
• Tshitupa tshia kumpala katshiena tshilenga to.

Tungunuka anyi?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (new in v3.17):

• Udi utangila keybox wa mpindieu ne Google revocation list (CRL).
• Udi uteta mishindu ya bungi too ne padibu bapeta keybox mukezuke.
• Automatic backup + restarts #000## midimu.

⚠️ Udi dijinga ne internet (1-3 min). Tungunuka?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Angata tshibombi tshia ku Enternete:

• Udi umbula tshibombi tshia mudimu ne utshijadika.
• Tshiteka bua kashidi (katshiena tshipingana ku Enternete to). Tungunuka?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Re-provision RKP keys:

• No data or keybox files is deleted.
• Read the phone afterwards.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Dilongolola dijima:

• Re-provisions RKP + restarts Google services.
• Tshiamu tshidi tshituadija tshiakabidi (kakuena tshintu tshidi tshijimina).

Kutungunuka anyi?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Restart Google services:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — restart only.
• Kakuena tshintu tshidi tshijimija ne kuena mua kupatuka to.
• Tshiamu tshidi tshituadija tshiakabidi.
000#Continue?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• Bua biamu bidi kabiyi bitaba tshibuta tshia tuzubu tshidi tshipatuka.
• Bidi bienza mudimu nansha biobi bikale bimpe.
• Kakuena malu adibu bafute to.

Tungunuka anyi?
strings.confirmCertify:
Force Play Store certification:

• Clear only the Store cache — your account is nottouched.
• Reboot, then open the Store.

Continue?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• Udi utuadija kabidi mudimu wa vendor.soter.
• Udi umbusha SOTER anu malu adi mu tshiamu tshia mudimu.

Utungunuke anyi?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Ela tshimanyinu tshia munu (PIF):

• Udi ukudimuna custom.pif.prop ne umuteka mu njila wa motere.
• Bidi bikengela kutuadija kabidi pashishe.

Tungunuka anyi?
strings.confirmCanary:
Kulongolola tshimanyishilu tshia Canary:

• Udi umbula tshimanyishilu tshia Canary tshia lelu tshia ku Google.
• Udi wenza mudimu ne tshiamu tshia bukubi + udi utuadija kabidi Google midimu (kakuyi dijimija).

⚠️ Udi dijinga ne internet (1-3min). Tungunuka?
